gizmo.title: Masewera okumbukira
gizmo.description: Tembenuzani makadi kuti mupeze awiriawiri. Phatikizani liwu ndi tanthauzo lake kuti kufanana kusonyeze kumvetsa, kapena gwiritsani ntchito zolemba kapena zithunzi ziwiri zofanana.

configure.title: Mutu
configure.description: Funso lowonetsedwa pamutu, mwachitsanzo: Fananitsani liwu ndi ntchito yake.

configure.title: Awiriawiri
configure.description: Awiriawiri aliwonse ndi makadi awiri ogwirizana, nthawi zambiri liwu ndi tanthauzo lake. Mbali iliyonse ikufunika zolemba, chithunzi, kapena zonse ziwiri.

advanced.title: Mtundu wowonetsa
advanced.description: Mtundu wosankha wa chizindikiro cha pamutu, kumbuyo kwa makadi ndi batani.
